data.one_liner: A CLI tool to verify code coverage thresholds in CI/CD and git hooks.
data.what_it_does: It checks if your test code coverage meets a minimum threshold and can block builds if it falls short. It also includes untested files in reports and filters out unwanted files using suffixes, regex, or content patterns.
use_when: You want to enforce minimum code coverage thresholds in CI/CD pipelines.
You need to include untested files in Flutter code coverage reports for higher accuracy.
You want to filter out generated files or specific patterns from coverage metrics.
avoid_when: You are looking for an in-app state management or UI component library.
strengths: Blocks app builds when code coverage drops below the defined threshold.
Includes untested files that Flutter does not natively track.
Provides flexible file exclusion via suffixes, regular expressions, and content patterns.
weaknesses: Requires command-line setup and configuration within CI/CD pipelines or scripts.
data.setup_notes: Activate globally using `pub global activate dlcov` or add as a dev dependency in `pubspec.yaml`.
